title: The Second Warning
text: Come to think of it, where exactly are the Crimson Swine’s cronies hiding this time around? Lazy Pig, perhaps sniffing out the winning side, was napping with all her might over on our faction’s turf. Having apparently decided to bet on the winning horse, she was putting in the bare minimum of circus work while doing her utmost to stay inconspicuous and uninvolved. Lazy Pig aside, I really needed to track down the rest of them and finish them off along with the Crimson Swine, I say. There was a real possibility that some of them had been present when Fleon-chan suffered and died. When I poisoned the Crimson Swine, I’d simply left them be, but this time—where in the world had they gone? If I went searching carelessly, Rival would catch on, so caution was required.

…Perhaps it was because winning Itsuki over proved too difficult, so they never invited him along this loop. Even in the loop where I’d stayed put in Melromarc, I hadn’t found them. Now that I think of it… the loop where I poisoned the Crimson Swine was quite nostalgic. I’d meant to summon the Filolial Sage there and show it the Crimson Swine suffering, but the poison had been too strong and simply killed it outright. This time, I wouldn’t go that far—I’d settle for just showing it drinking its own poison and writhing in agony.

I did plan to invite the Sage this time too. The whole Melromarc incident had wrapped up, after all. And more than anything, once the Queen learned of Fleon-chan, her eyes would surely light up—there’d be no shortage of things to talk about. The one difference from that earlier loop was that this time, since the Crimson Swine had arrived and been judged fairly early in the morning, there was quite a stretch of time before tonight’s party would even begin. With that in mind, we’d all been given free time at the castle until the party started. I could tell Rafumi, disguised as Ren, was having some detailed conversation with the Queen about something.

And then Father went off to speak with the Queen too. Something about formally apologizing for what the Crimson Swine had done, plus some fine details, and consulting about what was needed regarding Éclair’s territory, or so Father had said. And so, sometime past noon, once Father had finished his talk, he came back over here. Rafumi got called in as the replacement.
—Danger!—Danger!—Danger!
I’d been watching Yuki-chan playing in the castle garden through the window when suddenly countless warning signs flooded my field of vision.
“Whoa!?”
“Vof!?”
Father and Wolf both cried out in unison. I was startled too, by the sudden appearance of it all. I recognized this alarm! Still, it caught me quite off guard, appearing so suddenly, I say!
“What is this!?”
“Vof, I don’t know what danger I’m supposed to be on guard against, but my spine—!?”
“What’s wrong?”
“Ooh, it’s giving me the chills!”
Filo-tan was nearby too, her fur standing on end. Apparently Fiancée had come over to Father’s side because she needed to have a family-only talk.
“Motoyasu-sama—!? Something’s making my spine go cold!!”
Yuki-chan and the others, who’d been happily playing in the castle garden, came rushing over.
“Huh? What is this? Is this seriously bad?”

Kuro-chan was also glancing around nervously as he spoke. The way he reacted was so similar to Black Thunder that it confirmed they were one and the same person. By the way, Kuro-chan had come to pester Itsuki because Rafumi had gotten roped into a tedious tea party with the Queen and Fiancée.
“Naofumi-san. Seems like some kind of event has occurred.”
“Good that Itsuki’s sensing the danger too, but aren’t you also kind of excited?”

“Actually, I am. I wonder what on earth is happening? Could Melromarc be facing total destruction? Is some so-called superior human about to do something reckless out of spite, with the weapon sounding the alarm to warn us?”
Itsuki answered with a chuckle, his face betraying a hint of anticipation, I say.
“Nano? Something’s happening, nano?”
Rival swiftly placed a hand on Father’s shield and Wolf’s claws.
“An alarm… and for something like this to happen in this situation… the Spear Hero?”
“I haven’t done anything, I say. I’d appreciate it if people stopped blaming everything on me.”
“Ah, so it’s not like Motoyasu-kun did something? Scary that he might do it without even realizing… but at least he’s been with us this whole time today.”
“Indeed. Rival, you were in nearly the same place as me the whole time too, so you should know as well, I say.”
At the very least, we’d all just been enjoying the peaceful stretch of time after the Crimson Swine’s judgment, simply waiting around while preparing for the party.
“That’s certainly true, nano… but this presence… it’s coming from over there, nano!”
Rival spread her wings and pointed toward the royal family’s residential area of the castle. We rushed over there, and…
“M-Malty! MALTYYYYYYYYYYYYY!”

Trash’s scream echoed out. Oh? Now what was going on here? Fiancée, Tiger Girl, Tiger Guy, and even the Queen were forcibly dragging Trash away to keep their distance. And beyond them, Rafumi, disguised as Ren, stood with weapon raised, aimed at a lifeless Crimson Swine.
“Impossible… impossible… this cannot be!”
Trash was flailing about here, looking as though he somehow understood exactly what was happening.
“There’s no way! There’s no way this should be allowed to happen, aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

No mistaking it, I say. That line, that flow… the Crimson Swine! Why is it dead from poison again, I ask you!? And what’s more, this was the exact death pattern of a direct dose of concentrated Ouroboros venom! Damn it allllll! I was so frustrated I stomped the ground hard, I say!
“T-this is…!?”

Rival seemed to have pieced it together from the situation, and was staring at Rafumi disguised as Ren. The thing that had been the Crimson Swine twitched and convulsed, sprouting countless flesh-like vines that began stretching outward. No mistaking it, I say. The label for Ouroboros’s Apostle was clearly displayed.
“—An Apostle of Ouroboros?”
Father was the first to speak the name of what had been the Crimson Swine.
“Whoa… what is that? Has its true form been revealed? Like… it got cornered and went berserk or something?”
Itsuki rushed over and, watching the Crimson Swine’s corpse transform, asked without any real sense of caution.
“Amaki-sama, please be careful! Dispatch the magic corps at once! Begin the Judgment chant! Quickly! This is the royal family’s residential district, but we’re abandoning it! Hurry!”
The Queen spoke with an urgency bordering on desperation.
“What is that thing?”
“Heroes, please be careful as well! That thing erodes living creatures and grows at a terrifying rate! You must never touch it!”
“You know about it?”
Father looked at the Queen, then turned his gaze toward Rival, then me. He also shot a suspicious glance toward Rafumi. Just how in the world had things ended up like this?
“What’s with all this leisurely dawdling, <Emergency Time>. To overcome this crisis swiftly, I must take the lead and finish it off myself! The time has come for <Catastrophe Judgment>.”
“That thing… that thing used to be Malty, you know! Stop it, stop it, stop iiiiiit!”
“You understand this too, don’t you! Just hurry! Before it’s too late! Heroes! Please!”
“Take this! Haaaaaaaaaaaah!”
With that, Rafumi swung down the hammer disguised as a sword and smashed the Crimson Swine’s corpse, which had gone all misshapen and was writhing about.
“Vanish into the darkness!”
Seizing the opportunity, Rafumi delivered the finishing blow to what had once been the Crimson Swine… and a shockwave rippled outward across the area.
“It’s still moving!”
Tch… no helping it, I say! I’m joining in too!
“Liberation Flamefloor X!”

I never imagined I’d end up dealing with this the same way as the loop where I reunited with Fleon-chan. Just when its true colors had finally been revealed, I’d wanted to ship it off to the Pig King, make all sorts of proposals, and really make it suffer—what a shame this all turned out to be, I say!
“Haaaaaaah! Mjolnir X!”

And with that, Rafumi hurled the hammer, and the thing that had been the Crimson Swine dissolved entirely into light. And so, just like that, the Apostle of Ouroboros was wiped out with surprising ease.
